baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired forms at words 11/15, the two castings at 12/19, and the sequence at 16 then 22-24 form a transmission-correction chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: A messenger recites a carried communication; a rebellious agent throws alien material into that recitation; God removes it with replacement and then makes the signs firm. The second casting repeats the contaminating action inside the corrective clause, so intrusion and correction remain visibly distinct.

activation_trace.role: Carried speech and its bearer supply the literal communication channel in which the mechanism operates.
The God-reporting prophetic office specifies that this is a revelatory rather than ordinary speech channel.
Reading or recitation makes the wish-word pair the medium into which foreign material can enter.
Throwing something onto or toward another supplies the intrusive transfer at both repeated verbs.
A defiant transgressor supplies the adversarial agency responsible for the foreign cast.
Removal followed by a replacement supplies a corrective operation rather than mere disappearance.
Making something tight, reliable, and finished supplies the positive stabilization after removal.
A manifest sign identifies what is stabilized and kept distinguishable from the intrusion.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely reports that prophetic wishing can be frustrated.
changed_reading.after: The ayah describes a vulnerable recitation channel together with an explicit divine remove-and-firm correction protocol.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same words 11/15 can name an inwardly pictured aim, while words 13, 16, and 22 mark bending, transformation, and restraint.
baseline_models.mechanism: The prophetic aim is pictured inwardly; an adversarial pressure bends or loads that aim; God changes the cast out of its corrupt state and restrains the result toward repair. This model coexists with recitation because the focus inventory keeps both branches live.

activation_trace.role: A desire pictured by the heart supplies an inward aim rather than a spoken text.
A thrown addition supplies the external pressure laid onto the inward aim.
Contrariness, crookedness, and severity characterize how the pressure bends the aim.
Transformation out of a prior state allows correction to re-form rather than simply erase the cast.
Restraint that turns back corruption for repair supplies governance of the redirected aim.

changed_reading.before: The paired wish terms must denote recited wording.
changed_reading.after: They can also denote a prophetic aim exposed to distortion but redirected without erasing the mission itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The universal construction over every messenger or prophet, joined to prior time and successive divine actions, resists reduction to one isolated event.
baseline_models.mechanism: Messenger after messenger enters the same transmission ecology: sending, exposure to an alien cast, corrective succession, and stabilization. Historical recurrence is part of the claim, not merely introductory scenery.

activation_trace.role: Successive bands arriving one after another supply the repeated historical distribution of messengers.
Temporal precedence opens the mechanism backward across earlier missions.
The prophetic reporting office keeps each recurrence attached to divine communication.
One thing succeeding another supplies a process repeated across times and missions.
Reliable finishing supplies the invariant endpoint of each historical cycle.

changed_reading.before: The ayah explains a singular prophetic episode.
changed_reading.after: It states a recurrent ecology of exposure and correction across the messenger sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cast can propagate beyond an utterance through followers who turn it into twisted disputation. The adversarial event therefore has a social uptake path as well as an inward or textual location.

activation_trace.role: Throwing supplies the initiating transfer whose downstream path is being reconstructed.
Twisted, interlaced contention supplies the public form taken by the intrusion.
Following behind supplies the transmission link from adversarial source to human disputant.
The rebellious agent recurs outside the focus and connects the focus casting to social allegiance.
Being stripped of good until defiant intensifies the adversarial character of that allegiance.

structural_cues: 22:3 sequences disputing without knowledge, following, and a rebellious shaytan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following and twisted dispute around a rebellious agent; I supply the arrow from the focus casting to public propagation. A wholly interior or textual insertion remains live.

changed_reading.before: The satanic cast occurs only inside the prophet's wording or desire.
changed_reading.after: It can also name a socially propagated distortion generated around the prophetic act by adversarial followers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Firming the signs also functions as adjudication: rival materials or claims are separated, judged, and assigned their proper standing. Textual stabilization and judicial discrimination remain coexisting senses of the same focus verb.

activation_trace.role: Judgment between parties activates an adjudicative alternative within the focus act of firming.
A judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the discriminating operation.
God judging between groups confirms that the root's judicial force is active in this surah.
Repeated judgment between disputants extends the same operation to unresolved disagreement.
Parties taking divergent paths supplies the rival material that requires adjudication.

structural_cues: 22:17 separates confessional groups on the day of judgment; 22:56 and 22:69 repeat that God judges between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated divine judgment amid divergence; I infer that the focus firming can assign standing to rival casts as well as tighten wording. The live alternative confines the later judgments to eschatology.

changed_reading.before: God's second action is only editorial strengthening after deletion.
changed_reading.after: It can also be a ruling that distinguishes authoritative signs from competing claims without collapsing their conflict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between an authorized sequence being recited and a fabricated saying to be avoided sharpens the recitation baseline. Satanic casting becomes counterfeit speech inserted into or set against an authorized recitative sequence.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the focus medium whose authorization is clarified by the context.
Removal with replacement supplies the response to counterfeit speech.
Following in sequence supplies the authorized recitative stream already being delivered.
Attributing speech that was not so supplies the mechanism of verbal counterfeiting.
Falsehood and fabrication identify the counterfeit quality of the rival saying.

structural_cues: 22:30 places what is recited and the command to avoid false speech in one legal-ritual sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an authorized recitation and a forbidden fabricated saying; I infer that their contrast illuminates the focus intrusion. The inward-desire branch of the focus terms remains viable.

changed_reading.before: The focus wish terms lean primarily toward inward desire.
changed_reading.after: They strongly support recitation, with the satanic cast functioning as counterfeit speech opposed to the authorized sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The signs can be enacted markers as well as verbal units. Their effective reach is directed through guarded hearts rather than exhausted by material performance, so satanic distortion may target the heart-sign relation while divine firming preserves it.

activation_trace.role: A visible marker allows the focus signs to extend beyond sentence-like units.
Reliable fastening supplies preservation of the sign relation through enactment.
A signifying ritual marker supplies an enacted counterpart to the focus signs.
Placing the self in protection locates the ritual marker's force in guarded inward reception.
The heart supplies the receiving site in which the sign's orientation is preserved or distorted.
Reaching or attaining distinguishes material performance from the inward value that reaches its proper end.
Self-protection again names the inward quality that, unlike flesh or blood, reaches the divine end.

structural_cues: 22:32 locates reverence for ritual signs in hearts; 22:37 denies material reach while affirming the reach of inward guarding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted markers and heart-directed reach; I infer that the focus correction protects a sign-to-heart relation. The alternative keeps the focus signs strictly verbal and these ritual signs only analogous.

changed_reading.before: The stabilized signs are only corrected textual clauses.
changed_reading.after: They may also be enacted markers whose integrity depends on ethical reception in the heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurrent messenger ecology does not imply one undifferentiated ritual form. Distinct communities receive distinct rites, while adversarial distortion can emerge through contention over them; correction secures divine orientation without erasing legitimate plurality.

activation_trace.role: Successive messenger bands provide the historical plurality to be qualified.
A community or kind supplies the plural social recipients of distinct rites.
A designated ritual place or act supplies the differentiated form assigned to each community.
Continuance on a path turns each rite into a durable communal practice rather than a momentary act.
Pulling between two sides supplies the contention that can distort relations among legitimate forms.

structural_cues: 22:34 and 22:67 repeat that each community has a rite; 22:67 immediately bars contention with the messenger over the matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural assigned rites and a prohibition on contention; I infer that some satanic distortion operates in contest over forms rather than in their divine origin. The alternative treats these ritual verses as independent legislation.

changed_reading.before: A universal correction process implies uniform outward transmission across all communities.
changed_reading.after: The process can preserve a common divine orientation across legitimately differentiated rites while correcting adversarial contention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The foreign cast is not only removed; it becomes a diagnostic stress that differentiates receivers. Diseased or hardened hearts disclose one response, while knowledgeable hearts recognize truth and settle. The remove-and-firm sequence therefore stabilizes signs while exposing receiver quality.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the foreign input subjected to the contextual test.
Removal with replacement supplies the corrective phase after exposure.
Firm finishing supplies the stable reference against which receiver responses become visible.
Testing both metal and person supplies the diagnostic assay image for the satanic cast.
Diminished clarity and darkening characterize one receiver condition exposed by the test.
Material hardness and dryness give the hard-heart phrase a resistant texture within the assay.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the contrasting successful recognition response.
Stable correspondence with reality identifies what the knowledgeable receiver recognizes.
A low, settled tract supplies the spatial image of a heart subsiding before recognized truth.
A fire dying down supplies a coexisting quenching image for the heart after adversarial excitation.

structural_cues: 22:53 explicitly makes what shaytan casts a trial and contrasts diseased and hard hearts; 22:54 contrasts knowledge, truth-recognition, belief, and heart-submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a metal/person test, resistant hearts, recognition, settling, and quenching; I supply the assay arrow from casting through correction to disclosed receiver quality. A purely moral test without material imagery remains live.

changed_reading.before: The satanic cast is an accident whose only function is to be deleted.
changed_reading.after: While still corrected, it also becomes a diagnostic exposure that sorts resistant from truth-responsive reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Firmness belongs to the signs, not automatically to every receiver. Continuing doubt and later denial show that divine stabilization does not compel universal recognition, so objective integrity and subjective uptake must be kept separate.

activation_trace.role: Reliable firmness belongs to the signs as the stable object of reception.
The manifest marker remains available even when a receiver resists it.
Doubt and hesitation supply the continuing failure of subjective uptake.
Oscillation supplies a coexisting motion image for receivers who never settle on the firm sign.
Covering the truth supplies active denial after the signs have been stabilized.
The same manifest-sign branch anchors denial to the object whose firmness did not force assent.

structural_cues: 22:55 says unbelievers continue in doubt; 22:57 then names denial of the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ongoing doubt and denial after the focus correction; I infer a distinction between stabilized object and unforced reception. The alternative places the full resolution only at the final hour.

changed_reading.before: Making the signs firm removes ambiguity for every audience.
changed_reading.after: It secures the signs without coercing assent; doubt and denial can coexist with objective stabilization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs can remain intact while hostility gathers around their recitation. On this reading, satanic casting may occur in the reception field as projected aggression or a scheme against reciters, not only as content inserted into the recitation.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the focus event around which a hostile reception field can form.
Casting toward something permits the intrusion to be located around or against the recitative event.
Repeated sequential recitation supplies an intact public delivery event.
Manifest disclosure confirms that hostility need not imply obscurity in the signs themselves.
Near-performance supplies the imminent movement from hostile recognition toward action.
The split mapping's stratagem branch preserves a coexisting reading of organized hostility rather than mere imminence.
A consequential report answers the hostile reception with a counter-announcement.

structural_cues: 22:72 places clear recited signs, hostile recognition in faces, and near assault in one scene.
The branchless root س ط و at 22:72 word 13 is used only as structural evidence for assault; no branch ID is invented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intact clear recitation and near aggression against reciters; I infer that an adversarial cast can be projected into the social field around revelation. Actual content insertion remains a distinct live reading.

changed_reading.before: Satanic material must enter the verbal content itself.
changed_reading.after: It may instead or also enter reception as hostile projection and action while the recited signs remain clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger is part of a selected channel that extends into a witnessing community. Correction is therefore relational and accountable: carried speech is selected, borne, witnessed, and publicly answerable rather than left as an isolated private experience.

activation_trace.role: The bearer of carried speech supplies the focus channel whose wider accountability is activated.
Selecting a purified choice supplies divine channel selection before transmission.
Messengers as carriers of communication connect selection directly to the focus office.
The carried-message office is placed inside a final witness relation rather than left solitary.
Presence with observation supplies the accountable witness chain from messenger to community.

structural_cues: 22:75 selects messengers from angels and humans; 22:78 makes the messenger witness over the community and the community witnesses over people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection and a two-level witness relation; I infer that these form a public accountability architecture around the focus correction. The alternative treats selection and witnessing as status claims only.

changed_reading.before: The focus event concerns an isolated prophet and a private divine repair.
changed_reading.after: It belongs to a selected, witnessed transmission channel whose correction can be publicly carried and tested.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the reproductive branch of the focus wish-root through 22:5's staged formation. It remains anchored to both focus occurrences and to transformation then firming, but downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy, not claim that the focus syntax lexically means semen.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus occurrences of م ن ي, followed by state-change and firm formation, can carry a branch-level seed analogy.

activation_trace.role: Generative fluid from which form is measured supplies the latent seed image in the focus pair.
Changing a thing out of its prior state supplies developmental transformation after contamination.
Completed, reliable formation supplies the mature endpoint of the analogy.
A fluid ranging from drop to generative substance activates the focus root's seed branch.
Measuring and proportioning supplies the formative rule governing the staged material.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes only speech or desire contamination.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, it can depict a generative input exposed to alien admixture, transformed, and brought to stable sign-form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because 22:15 supplies a rope-link, cutting, and stratagem rather than vocabulary identical to the focus correction. It remains anchored to the focus removal and firming sequence; downstream prose should call it a causal-spatial analogy, not translate ن س خ as cutting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus removal at word 16 followed by firming at 22 can be modeled as disabling the connection by which the adversarial cast exerts force.

activation_trace.role: Removal with a successor supplies the focus-side disabling operation.
Secure fastening supplies the state reached after the adversarial link is disabled.
A rope or connective link supplies the causal tether through which a scheme could act.
Severing supplies the contextual image for disabling that tether.
A stratagem identifies the hostile purpose whose connection is being neutralized.

changed_reading.before: Divine correction edits an intrusive object already inside the message.
changed_reading.after: It may analogically sever the causal tether that lets an adversarial scheme act on the message, then secure the signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the focus act of throwing onto 22:65's held sky and permitted fall. It remains anchored to the repeated focus casting verbs and divine restraint, but downstream prose should present it as a scale analogy about bounded agency, not as cosmological exegesis of the focus.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus castings can be read spatially as falls whose effects are bounded by the divine remove-and-restrain sequence.

activation_trace.role: Throwing supplies the local downward or outward motion being bounded.
Restraint for repair supplies the divine boundary on the cast's effect.
Holding and confining supplies the larger architecture that prevents uncontrolled falling.
Falling and coming to rest supplies the primary spatial analogue for the adversarial cast.
The split mapping preserves a coexisting image of height followed by falling upon something.
Permission supplies the boundary condition under which a fall can take effect.

changed_reading.before: The adversarial cast acts as an autonomous penetration of revelation.
changed_reading.after: Its motion and effect remain bounded within a larger architecture of divine holding, permission, removal, and restraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the copying sense of ن س خ and the dictation sense carried by the later م ل ل inventory. It remains anchored to the direct object of the focus copying verb, speech transfer, knowledge, and firming; downstream prose should use it only as an archival analogy and must not assert a historical scribal event.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 16 can mean copying while an original remains, making an inspectable-record reading possible before the signs are secured.

activation_trace.role: Speech delivered for reception or instruction supplies transmissible verbal material.
Copying a written image while its source remains supplies archival capture rather than deletion.
Reliable finishing distinguishes the authoritative signs from the captured intrusion.
Ordered letters and a written record supply an explicit archival environment.
Known disclosure supplies inspectability of what the record contains.
Speech dictated to a writer supplies the branch-distant transfer image that activates controlled inscription.

changed_reading.before: God's copying verb can only mean erasing the satanic material.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it may mean capturing the intrusion in an inspectable record before distinguishing and firming the authoritative signs.

strongest_changes: The 22:30 contrast between recited material and fabricated speech strongly activates a recitation-versus-counterfeit mechanism.
The immediate 22:53-54 sequence changes simple deletion into a diagnostic process that exposes resistant and truth-responsive hearts.
Repeated judgment language changes firming from purely editorial work into adjudication among rival claims.
The clear yet violently received recitation in 22:72 preserves a distinct model in which satanic casting occurs in reception around the text rather than inside its wording.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported simultaneous recitation, inward-desire, historical-process, judicial, ritual-semiotic, social-propagation, and receiver-assay readings. The packet also kept contained material, spatial, and archival activations alive without forcing them into a single interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus morphology does not force a choice between recitation and inwardly pictured desire.
The location of the satanic cast remains open among verbal content, inward aim, social propagation, and hostile reception.
The generative, severed-tether, governed-fall, and archival models are branch-driven analogies rather than lexical disambiguations.
The relation between divine removal and the later use of the cast as a trial may be causal, sequential, or both.
